description: No old design or calls. Unit21 rejected rectangle+diagonal lines due to new crossing and apparent triangle targets. This design uses only three disjoint parallel segments between six original dot centers, with zero crossings or new dots. It binds actual equal-length column pairs and targets one-vertex-per-column restriction:2^3 triples minus2 collinear rows=6, omitting12 triangles using both members of a column. All requested18 triangles still use only original dots. Nonstyleable native point artists are untouched; no overlaid marker or size change.
